asset.name: Toast
asset.description: The transient notification rendered through the shared toast service, with queueing, deduplication, in-place updates, action affordances, timeout policy, and announcement.

requires.reason: Queue, dedupe, limits, and lifetime belong to the service, not the component.
Background and elevation come from the shared surface primitive.
Enter and exit lifecycle and reduced-motion collapse are owned once.
Messages are announced through the one shared live region.

rationale: Deliberately constrained to transient confirmation and background results. A blocking failure recorded only in a toast the user can miss is the anti-pattern this entry names explicitly.
